fields.quoted_span: If you do begin an eviction process through a notice to quit or other action, it is required that you offer the Guide about rights and resources at the same time.
fields.note: Both delivery points, the tenant-at-will coverage, no renewal requirement, no signature requirement, the eviction-not-barred point and the $300 per-day fine are all stated in the FAQ.

fields.quoted_span: You may be fined $300 for each day’s violation.
fields.note: The $300 per day fine and the timing of the Guide at tenancy start and at termination steps are both in the document.
The record's effective_date is null. The document gives only page posting and modification dates, not an ordinance effective date, so the null value is correct.

fields.quoted_span: The Ordinance requires owners, landlords, and management companies to provide you with information at the start of your lease or tenancy as well as when your tenancy is being terminated.
fields.note: The FAQ describes the ordinance in the present tense as a current requirement, which is consistent with in_force.

fields.quoted_span: Yes, the Ordinance applies to a residential rental agreements, including single residential dwelling unit.
fields.note: The coverage text matches the document, including the exemptions for hospital, skilled nursing and health facilities, non-profit short-term substance-abuse facilities, and Short Term Rental Units under § 4.60.
